notes.title: Roman Empire Wod#1 (V0.11.0)
notes.content:
To those who are about to play, we salute you!

We recently completed our Wrath of Devs expansion Kickstarter campaign, and today we're excited to deliver our first content.


This update includes a new “Roman Empire” pack, new dice, Bloodlines theme 3d tokens and user custom billboards and a complete new Quest “The Mines of Velta” (5e Compatible). 
Monday we'll begin sending out keys for the WoD DLC to our amazing Kick starters supporters. 

❤️Thank you all so much for your continued support!❤️

But that's not all, after receiving substantial community feedback regarding scaling in RPGs, we decided to rebalance the scale of everything. From now on, our base tile will represent 5 feet, making it easier to design narrow dungeons and improving overall balance. To ensure a smooth transition, older and ongoing projects will not be affected by this change. 
Only new projects will use the new scaling. If you wish to manually override the scaling in your project, you can find a toggle switch in the project info window under the file menu.

For more info check out this blog post on our website: https://www.rpgstories.net/post/new-scale-new-rpgs

Change Log:

 Added Roman Empire Kits bash , extra characters and objects (Wod Exclusive)
 New dice (fallout, fudge)
 New layer type 3d tokens
 8 Bloodlines themed 3d tokens
 New Free Quest - “The Mines of Velta” (5e Compatible) 
 New Demos scenes
 RPGS World scaled adjusted.
 Various Bug Fixes

notes.title: Multi Level Building and Doors Completed! (V0.9.0)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We're thrilled to announce that our latest update is now available on Steam!

Multi-Level Building
The community requested feature is here! 
You can now build on different levels of your world, taking your creations to new heights—literally. Use the level tools on the left sidebar to choose the level you want to build on. All tile-based layers will automatically adjust to the selected level, and the ground collision will rise accordingly, making it easier to build complex structures at various heights.

Doors
We've finally completed the door feature! After much work, we found a solution to cut through walls. Hurra! We've also added a UI icon, allowing you to open doors directly from the simple selection tool.

Other Updates

 Scalable UI: You can now adjust the UI size.
 Reset Settings: Easily reset all settings to default.
 Improved 2D Token Height: Enhanced internal height for 2D tokens.
 Duplication Fix: Fixed the issue causing multiple duplications.
 Corrected LUT visible state when changing Environments.
 Various smaller bugs have been fixed for a smoother experience.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update! (V0.5.0.775b)
notes.content:
With this release we bring multiplayer only to the GM version but our next update will be solely focused on completing the players version and finally share Your Stories with everyone.

After that things will only get better! With more frequent updates and the with community on our side to guide us about future features and the overall direction of the RPGS.



Current Multiplayer Features

For Now, the Game Masters can do the following:

Decide which environment tab the players see.
Add Spawn Points for the players in these environments.
Force the camera to a certain position for all players.
Add colliders to shape the pathfinding of the player characters.
Use the world-builder in session.
Add VFX live.
Move all characters, NPCs, and monsters.
Add/remove Fog of War.
Roll the dice.
Use the pinpoint tool, the pen tool, the spells, and the measure when needed.


For Now, the Players can do the following:

Join the GM’s game.
Choose the character they want from our collection of models.
Name their character.
Adjust the number of the character’s HP and update in session.
Move their character in the GM’s environment.
Force the camera to track their character.
Change the model of the character during the game (Polymorph players will love this!).
Roll dice.
Open and close the chat, text, or check your party's roll dice.
Use the pinpoint tool, the pen tool, and the measure when needed.



To get you started you can watch the following tutorial posted below.
Also later today join us for a for a presentation Stream at 22:30 CET where I'll go through the multiplayer features and show you some tips on how to setup and run a game.

https://www.twitch.tv/rpgstoriesvtt/


[previewyoutube=sIbDF92Gi88;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Premiere of Multiplayer is coming next week!
notes.content:
Greetings, RPG Stories Community!

We are excited to share the news that the first version of RPG Stories Multiplayer is coming next week!

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1032968121201475626/1166764068565155990/multiplayer.gif?ex=654bacb7&is=653937b7&hm=35b2bf5fa68dc46c764dfef95fcf77d9bc5ea76ea7fa0c9e4268fd26e3fb6545&

Anyone who owns the current version (GM Version) can prepare the 3D scenes/environments and host a game as a GM or join a game as a Player.

For Now, the Game Masters can do the following:

Decide which environment tab the players see.
Add Spawn Points for the players in these environments.
Force the camera to a certain position for all players.
Add colliders to shape the pathfinding of the player characters.
Use the world-builder in session.
Add VFX live.
Move all characters, NPCs, and monsters.
Add/remove Fog of War.
Roll the dice.
Use the pinpoint tool, the pen tool, the spells, and the measure when needed.


For Now, the Players can do the following:

 Join the GM’s game.
 Choose the character they want from our collection of models.
 Name their character.
 Adjust the number of the character’s HP and update in session.
 Move their character in the GM’s environment.
 Force the camera to track their character.
 Change the model of the character during the game (Polymorph players will love this!).
 Roll dice.
 Open and close the chat, text, or check your party's roll dice.
 Use the pinpoint tool, the pen tool, and the measure when needed.


As we already mentioned, this is the premiere of the online Multiplayer. We will be giving monthly updates that will improve the overall experience, the camera system, the VFX, and the animations/pathfinding.

Your feedback is important to us!

We would love to have your feedback and help us improve RPG Stories.
Join our Brave Alice Discord server and let us know what you like in RPG Stories, report the bugs, and share your future ideas that would improve the overall gameplay experience!


The Player Version is coming soon as well! This is for the users who do not want to be the Game Masters and thus, they don’t need full access to full access to our collection of 5K assets and features to create their environments. Of course, you will be able to upgrade your Player Version to the GM version at any time you want.

notes.title: Góðan Dag Everyone, Update V0.3.8.590b is here!
notes.content:
As we press forward in our quest for the VTT Era, we inevitably come across numerous adversaries and monsters along the way.
Among them is the Lag Troll, a formidable opponent. To combat its effects, we have made some refinements and optimizations to our app.

Our primary objective is to prevent any commands or actions from causing the app to freeze, such as loading an environment. By implementing certain changes, we have enabled asynchronous processes to handle these tasks more efficiently.

Please let us know how these modifications have impacted your experience. Your input is invaluable to us.


And of course Moar Content! 

Log cabins and wooden houses
Viking props and weapons
New Medieval floors and walls
2 new scifi floors
1 mud ground and floor
RPGS team characters: Rexal the Hobgoblin and Gamarassaur


And Code Changelog for my beloved super nerds that do want to know!-) 

Improved and Optimized Database system.
World Build optimization and improvements.
World Build “Async” loading:
	-Object don't all load at the same time but rather gradually,
        -Added a small tween to the object when loaded so they don't Just Pop Into existence (do you like it?)
Improved and Async Custom Objects load (Have you noticed that when refocusing the app it freezes for a bit? That should be smoothed out now)



Join us tomorrow for a livestream at 11:00 AM Pacific Time (PT) where we will provide an overview of our latest update and delve deep into the world of RPGs for newcomers. Veterans, please join us as well and share your world-building tips with us! 

RPG Stories Twitch Channel

notes.content:
Yes, indeed! We have populated RPGs with an additional 174 new characters, bringing the total count to 488. You now have a wide selection of NPCs to populate your environments with, or choose them as playable characters in the upcoming VTT Version. And there's more to come! We have even more characters in the pipeline for our next release.


Content Change Log:
New characters:

Fantasy: 88
Modern: 61
Scifi: 25

14 New object from modern era

App Change Log:
We added a new feature in our Collection Browser to assist you in navigating our extensive library. Now, when you enter a keyword in the search field, you can simply press enter, and that keyword will be added as a permanent search parameter.
You can add multiple keywords and Unlike the search field that narrows down your results, this tool will merge the results, allowing you to create personalised 'Pallets' of content.
The tags are also toggleable, making them a convenient way to quickly access your most frequently used search terms. Additionally, you can exclude certain results by adding an exclamation mark '!' at the beginning of your search terms.

Please watch this mini quick tutorial to help out with the explanations:

notes.title: RPG Stories Early Access is available now!
notes.content:
Hello GMs and Adventurers!

In October 2022, RPG Stories World-Builder / VTT got funded on Kickstarter and our team made a promise to deliver the project by October 2023. Although we are still under development we decided to deliver the keys to our backers three months ago and we are now happy to announce that we just released RPG Stories' World-Builder on Steam for Early Access!

Here is everything you need to know about this EA release:

- This is Early Access to the RPG Stories worldbuilding tools only.
- We will be doing a minimum of one update per month, delivering new models, new features, and bug fixes. You, the users, are part of the development now and your feedback is really important!
- The team is now working on the multiplayer VTT, hoping to deliver a lot sooner than promised to the users.
- Everything you build with RPG Stories is and will forever be commercial-free. Feel free to use your creations in any way you like.
- This version features more than 3K models. The final version will contain a lot more, more world-building features and of course the VTT multi-player.
- For as long as the project will be at early access status the price will remain lower than the final's version.

You can check the following links for tutorials, tips&hotkeys: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rOLVvJhCRXM&list=PLIQjkd9ATTq-OC61pHB0J8wtNWY8PLdZm&ab_channel=RPGStories

https://www.rpgstories.net/wiki


We wish you all to have fun and feel free to send your feedback to our discord server: https://discord.gg/KVYRWqyBHj


The Team would like to thank everyone who helped to make this dream come true...
The least we can do is offer a 15% discount for the first week of our release! 

Have a great week, beautiful people, and don't forget... It's all about your stories!
RPG Stories team
